transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been feeling like some people around here, in the arts and finance circles, are paying attention to me in a way that doesn’t feel normal. Like they know which clients I’m meeting with, and then I’ll see little signals in invitations or panel topics, or even where people sit at events.

I know it might sound like coincidence, but I can’t really shake it.
Have you been feeling unusually energized or high lately?
Not really. I mean… I’ve been a little on edge, maybe, but not high or unusually energized.
Do you believe for certain that these people are deliberately sending you messages or tracking you?

I… yeah. I mean, “certain” is a strong word, but it feels pretty deliberate to me. Like people in those circles know who I’m meeting with, and then things show up in invitations or panel topics, or someone ends up sitting near me in a way that feels like a message. I try to tell myself it could be coincidence, but I don’t really believe that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed anything like that when I’m alone.
Have you been feeling depressed معظم اليوم nearly every day?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had some low moments, but not… most of the day, every day.
How long have you been experiencing this sense that people are deliberately sending you messages or tracking you?
Probably… about two months. That’s when I started noticing the stuff around my client meetings and the signals.
Have other people told you that your speech has been hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?
Not really. I mean… maybe someone’s asked me to slow down or repeat myself, but I don’t think anyone’s said my thoughts were jumbled.
Over the past two months, have you found yourself losing motivation or interest in things you usually care about?

Yeah… a bit. I’m still doing my work, just kind of in pieces. But I don’t really have the same drive. I’ll let follow-ups sit longer than I should, and I’ve skipped jazz nights or pickup basketball and just… didn’t feel much about it. When friends ask, I usually just give short answers. Talking feels like effort.
Have you felt that your thoughts were being controlled or inserted by someone else?

Not exactly controlled, no. It’s more like… people are watching what I’m doing and sending signals around me. Like through invitations or panel topics, who ends up sitting near me at events. I know it can sound like coincidence, but I can’t really shake it.
Have you found yourself speaking much less than you used to lately?
Yeah… probably. I don’t really talk as much. If friends ask what’s going on, I’ll usually just give short answers. It just feels like more effort than it should.
Has this belief that people are deliberately sending you messages been present for three months or longer?
No… I don’t think it’s been three months. More like… about two months, maybe. The stuff with people tracking my client meetings and sending signals.
Have you had the feeling that other people can hear your thoughts?

Not really that they can hear my thoughts, no. It’s more… I feel like certain people are keeping track of who I meet with, and then there are these little signals afterward. Invitations, panel topics, where people sit near me… things like that. I know it might sound like coincidence, but I can’t quite drop it.
When you talk, do your thoughts ever get so mixed up that other people can’t follow what you’re saying?
I don’t think so. I mean… I can lose my train of thought sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed people not being able to follow me.
Did this start very suddenly, over a day or two?
No… not over a day or two. It’s been more gradual. I guess it started building after that arts nonprofit recognition… a little over two years ago.
For at least one full month, have you had these experiences nearly every day?
Yeah… I think so. The tracking and the little signals, that’s been happening pretty much every day for maybe two months.
Have these experiences caused serious problems in your work or relationships?

Some, yeah. I’m still working, but… my practice isn’t what it was. I miss follow-ups more than I should, and I’ve stopped doing some public panels. I just don’t keep up with clients the same way I used to.
From when these problems first began, has there been a full six months when you were affected by them?
Yeah… I mean, yes. It’s been more than six months. It’s been kind of building since that arts nonprofit thing, a little over two years ago.
For at least one month, have you had a time when your speech became clearly disorganized or hard for other people to follow?
I don’t think so. I mean… people have asked me to slow down sometimes, but I haven’t had a whole month where I was talking in a way people couldn’t follow.
Aside from feeling on edge about people tracking you, have you felt emotionally flat or less able to feel things than usual?

Yeah… somewhat. I wouldn’t say I feel nothing, but things feel kind of muted. I get work done in bits, but I don’t have the same drive. I’ll let client follow-ups sit longer than I should.

And outside work… I’ve skipped jazz nights, pickup basketball, stuff like that. I don’t really feel much about missing it. When friends ask, I just give short answers. Talking feels like more effort than it used to.
Have you ever felt that things like TV, radio, websites, or conversations between strangers were meant specifically for you?

Yeah… sometimes. Not like the TV talking to me exactly, but invitations, panel topics, even people’s conversations or where they sit at events… it can feel like there’s a message in it for me. Like people in those arts and finance circles here are signaling about me, or watching who I’m meeting with. I know it could be coincidence, but I can’t really shake it.
